name: Cards
author: Yu-Gi-Oh-Ex
description: Every card released after the game (mid-2019 on) and their tokens: stats, text and art. Effects come later.
details: Made by Tools/Scripts/make_cards_mod.py from YGOPRODeck (docs/Card Lists/Missing Cards.csv). Art is in Yu-Gi-Oh-Ex/art/<kind>/, one folder per kind. Tokens use the art of the card that summons them, as Konami's games do. Ids: tokens 21000+, cards 21100+, fixed in card-ids.json. No card has an effect yet, and none are owned (copies 0) until booster packs are added.
